summary: Iteration 57 — Post-refactor regression + Anonymous Nickname + Contributor Wall. Backend 30/30 pytest passing after fixing one test assertion (categories returns dict, not list — not a code bug). Verified every previously-passing endpoint still works after server.py -> deps/models/routes split. Verified nickname sanitization (7 invalid variants -> null, case preserved, valid stored). Verified /api/community/contributors is public, aggregates only nicknamed promoted tips, sorted tip_count DESC. Verified /api/community/promoted and /api/community/featured now surface nickname. Scheduler handle wired correctly — /digest/status returns non-null scheduler_next_run. Frontend Contributor Wall renders at both /contributors and /community/wall (2 seeded contributors: veggie_wizard, cook_ninja). Back link navigates to /. FeaturedTipStrip Heart icon -> /contributors target=_blank confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py refactor is clean — thin 102-line bootstrap, all routers wired, scheduler handle re-exposed to routes/digest.py via digest_module.scheduler = _scheduler on startup (verified /digest/status.scheduler_next_run is populated).

_sanitize_nickname is stricter than needed for common non-ASCII nicknames (e.g. 'josé', '寿司') — silent coerce to null is friendly but users get no error feedback. Consider surfacing a client-side validation hint (already exists per data-testid=share-nickname-input) so the coercion isn't invisible.
GET /api/community/contributors aggregation has no limit — fine now (2 contributors), but at scale add a top-N cap similar to the analytics endpoint feedback in iter56.

ContributorWall.jsx: `key={c.nickname}` is fine since backend groups by nickname. `wall-contributor-<nickname>` testid could break if a nickname ever contained CSS-selector-special chars — but sanitization limits to [A-Za-z0-9_] so safe.
FeaturedTipStrip Heart link uses <a target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer> — good; leaves the note app running.
TTL index on community_events (180d) is created idempotently in server.startup — good. Same TTL should be considered for community_tips.rejected but that's product-level policy.
iter56 recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning likely still present on admin dashboard (unchanged in this iteration); not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testid'd flows verified on /contributors, /community/wall, and home FeaturedTipStrip)

test_credentials: ADMIN_TOKEN=[REDACTED_ADMIN_TOKEN]. Admin UI unlock: localStorage.setItem('irr.admin_token', TOKEN) then load /admin/community.
seed_data_creation: Test file inserts TEST_iter57 tips (nickname variants + a promoted + an anonymous promoted) and cleans up in test_zzz_cleanup. Pre-existing seed 'veggie_wizard' + 'cook_ninja' promoted tips left in place — they power the Contributor Wall UI verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_refactor_regression.py is idempotent & safe to re-run. Uses env: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, ADMIN_TOKEN (defaults to [REDACTED_ADMIN_TOKEN]). Categories endpoint returns dict, not list — assertion loosened to accept both. Nickname regex is ^[A-Za-z0-9_]{2,20}$ enforced server-side; the 7 invalid variants tested cover the boundaries (empty, whitespace, 1-char, space, symbol, 21-char, hyphen). The CommunityShareDialog (data-testid=share-nickname-input) client-side validation was NOT interactively exercised by Playwright in this run — verified via code review only (regex mirror + server-side is authoritative). If retesting UI, open /admin/community, promote a pending tip, then re-visit / to see FeaturedTipStrip byline change.

verified_flows.regression_scheduler: GET /community/digest/status.scheduler_next_run is non-null → server.startup binding OK.
verified_flows.nickname_downstream: promote returns nickname; /community/promoted row has nickname; /community/featured tip schema includes nickname; /community/contributors aggregates non-null-only, sorted tip_count DESC + latest_promoted_at DESC.
verified_flows.contributor_wall_frontend: /contributors renders 2 cards (veggie_wizard, cook_ninja) with wall-contributor-<nick> testids; /community/wall alias renders identically; wall-back-link navigates to /.
verified_flows.featured_strip_frontend: FeaturedTipStrip mounts, Heart icon = /contributors target=_blank. (Today's featured tip 'Batch cook rice' has no nickname → byline correctly absent.)
